name: Sentinel of Nova Kai
summary: A body with Counterattack that costs you 1 Flux each of your turns while it stays on the Front.

face.name: Sentinel of Nova Kai
face.flavor: The answering blow is the only one it has always prepared.

effect.text: As long as this Entity remains on the Front, at the start of each of your turns you have 1 less Flux available for that turn.
